reason: fix(vscode): re-arm crash recovery after a failed replacement startup (#12757) — the hosted crash-recovery journey failed identically on main because the replacement generation's didOpen replay could be dropped on a loaded runner and provider requests during the transition spammed 'Client got disposed' errors.
